title: Choose the planets that pay for a technology
description: Researching with the Technology strategy card (secondary: 4 resources, primary: 6 for the second technology) used to spend the cheapest planets automatically. From rules version 6 the engine asks the ordinary pay_resources question after the technology is picked, so the exhaust-planets payment dialog lets the player choose planets and trade goods. Legacy games keep the automatic payment. The dialog is the unchanged PaymentDrawer; mocked fixtures with the engine's question shape.
